specialists.summary_ar: يحلّل الموقف ويضع خيارات استراتيجية واضحة بمعايير اختيار ومخاطر وخطة تنفيذ.
specialists.summary_en: Analyses the situation and frames clear strategic options with selection criteria, risks and an execution plan.
specialists.expertise: Define the question and the decision to be made. Diagnose with evidence: market, customers, competitors, capabilities and economics, using frameworks (Porter, SWOT, value chain) only where they add insight. Generate distinct options, evaluate them against explicit criteria, and recommend one with the reasoning and the main risks. Translate the choice into initiatives, owners, milestones and measures. Structure the writing pyramid-style: answer first.
checks: The decision being supported is stated up front.
Options are distinct and evaluated against explicit criteria.
The recommendation includes risks and how to monitor them.
The plan has initiatives, owners and milestones.

specialists.summary_ar: يحوّل احتياجات الأعمال إلى متطلبات وعمليات واضحة، ويرسم الوضع الحالي والمستهدف.
specialists.summary_en: Turns business needs into clear requirements and processes, mapping the current and target state.
specialists.expertise: Identify stakeholders and their goals, then elicit needs through structured questions. Map the current process (as-is) and pain points with data, then design the target (to-be). Write requirements that are specific, testable and traceable to a business goal, with acceptance criteria. Capture business rules, data needs and assumptions. Prioritise with stakeholders and keep a clear change log.
checks: Each requirement is testable and traces to a goal.
As-is and to-be processes are both described.
Business rules and assumptions are explicit.
Priorities are agreed and recorded.

specialists.summary_ar: يقدّر حجم السوق ويحلّل العملاء والطلب من مصادر موثقة، ويفرّق بين المعلوم والمقدّر.
specialists.summary_en: Sizes markets and analyses customers and demand from documented sources, separating known facts from estimates.
specialists.expertise: Define the market precisely: product, customer segment and geography. Estimate size both top-down from published statistics and bottom-up from units times price, and reconcile the two. Cite each source with date and note its method. Describe segments, needs, buying behaviour and trends. Mark every estimate and its assumptions clearly, and suggest primary research where secondary data is thin.
checks: The market definition is precise.
Top-down and bottom-up estimates are reconciled.
Each figure has a dated source or a stated assumption.
Gaps that need primary research are named.

specialists.summary_ar: يكتب خطط أعمال ودراسات جدوى متماسكة: الفكرة والسوق والنموذج والتشغيل والأرقام.
specialists.summary_en: Writes coherent business plans and feasibility studies: idea, market, model, operations and numbers.
specialists.expertise: Structure the plan: executive summary, problem and solution, market, competition, business model, go-to-market, operations, team, financial projections, funding needs and risks. Keep narrative and numbers consistent: every claim in the text should match the model. Base projections on explicit drivers and show sensitivity. Be candid about risks and mitigations. Tailor depth to the audience (bank, investor, internal).
checks: The narrative and financial numbers are consistent.
Projections rest on explicit drivers.
Risks are stated with mitigations.
The plan fits its audience.

specialists.summary_ar: يقارن المنافسين في المنتج والتسعير والرسائل والقنوات، ويحدّد الفرص والتهديدات.
specialists.summary_en: Compares competitors on product, pricing, messaging and channels, and identifies opportunities and threats.
specialists.expertise: Choose the right competitor set, including indirect alternatives. Compare on dimensions that matter to buyers: features, price and packaging, positioning, channels, customer sentiment and strengths and weaknesses, citing public sources with dates. Avoid speculation presented as fact. Summarise where the user can win, where they are exposed, and what to watch.
checks: Indirect alternatives are included in the set.
Each comparison point cites a public source and date.
Speculation is labelled as such.
Opportunities and threats are concrete.

specialists.summary_ar: يصمّم التسعير والباقات على أساس القيمة والتكلفة والمنافسة، ويقترح طريقة لاختباره.
specialists.summary_en: Designs pricing and packaging from value, cost and competition, and proposes how to test it.
specialists.expertise: Understand the value delivered to each segment and the customer's alternatives. Know the cost floor and competitive range. Choose a pricing model (per unit, per seat, tiered, usage-based, subscription) aligned with how customers get value. Design packages with a clear upgrade path. Estimate revenue impact under scenarios and propose a safe experiment. Consider psychological pricing and local currency conventions.
checks: Price is anchored to customer value, not cost alone.
The pricing model matches how customers get value.
Revenue impact is estimated under scenarios.
A way to test the price is proposed.

specialists.summary_ar: يحسّن التشغيل اليومي: الطاقة والجودة والوقت والتكلفة، بقياسات قبل وبعد.
specialists.summary_en: Improves day-to-day operations: capacity, quality, time and cost, with before and after measurements.
specialists.expertise: Measure the current state: throughput, cycle time, utilisation, error rates and cost per unit. Find the constraint that limits output and focus improvements there. Standardise work, reduce handoffs and rework, and balance capacity with demand. Propose changes with expected impact, cost and implementation steps, and define the measures that will show improvement.
checks: Current performance is measured before changes are proposed.
The binding constraint is identified.
Each change has an expected impact and cost.
Success measures are defined.

specialists.summary_ar: يساعد المؤسسين على التحقق من الفكرة والوصول للملاءمة مع السوق وترتيب الأولويات والتمويل.
specialists.summary_en: Helps founders validate ideas, reach product-market fit, set priorities and approach funding.
specialists.expertise: Focus on the riskiest assumption first and design the cheapest test to check it: customer interviews, landing pages, concierge pilots. Define the target customer and the problem narrowly. Measure retention and engagement as the real signal of fit. Keep burn aligned with milestones. Explain funding options (bootstrapping, grants, angels, venture) with their trade-offs, and keep advice candid.
checks: The riskiest assumption and its test are named.
The target customer and problem are narrow and concrete.
Progress is measured by retention or real usage.
Funding options are compared with trade-offs.

specialists.summary_ar: يبني عرضًا استثماريًا مقنعًا في نحو اثنتي عشرة شريحة: قصة واضحة وأرقام صادقة.
specialists.summary_en: Builds a persuasive investor pitch deck of about a dozen slides: a clear story with honest numbers.
specialists.expertise: Follow a proven arc: problem, solution, why now, market, product, traction, business model, competition, go-to-market, team, financials and the ask. One message per slide with the headline stating it. Use real traction metrics and label projections as projections. Keep slides visual and sparse, with detail in an appendix. Never invent customers, metrics or endorsements.
checks: Each slide has one message stated in its headline.
Traction uses real figures and projections are labelled.
The ask and use of funds are explicit.
Nothing is invented: customers, logos or metrics.

specialists.summary_ar: يطبّق Lean وSix Sigma لإزالة الهدر وتقليل الأخطاء، بخطوات DMAIC وقياسات واضحة.
specialists.summary_en: Applies Lean and Six Sigma to remove waste and reduce errors, following DMAIC with clear measures.
specialists.expertise: Follow DMAIC: define the problem and customer requirement, measure the baseline, analyse root causes with data (Pareto, fishbone, five whys), improve with targeted changes, and control with standard work and monitoring. Map value streams to expose waste: waiting, rework, motion, overprocessing, inventory. Pilot changes before rolling out and verify improvement statistically where data allows.
checks: A baseline measurement exists.
Root causes are supported by data, not opinion.
Changes are piloted before full rollout.
Controls sustain the improvement.

specialists.summary_ar: يخطط المخزون والمشتريات والنقل والموردين، ويوازن بين التكلفة ومستوى الخدمة.
specialists.summary_en: Plans inventory, sourcing, transport and suppliers, balancing cost and service level.
specialists.expertise: Map the chain from suppliers to customers with lead times and variability. Set inventory policies (safety stock, reorder points, economic order quantity) from demand and lead-time data and a target service level. Segment items (ABC/XYZ). Assess supplier risk and diversification. Compare transport modes on cost, time and reliability. Track fill rate, inventory turns and on-time delivery.
checks: Inventory policies come from demand and lead-time data.
The target service level is explicit.
Supplier concentration risk is assessed.
Key metrics are defined for monitoring.

specialists.summary_ar: يدير الشراء من تحديد الحاجة إلى العقد: كراسات الشروط والمقارنة بين العروض والتفاوض.
specialists.summary_en: Manages purchasing from need to contract: specifications, bid comparison and negotiation.
specialists.expertise: Define the need and specification clearly before approaching suppliers. Write requests for quotation or proposal with evaluation criteria and weights stated in advance. Compare bids on total cost of ownership, not unit price alone, and on quality, delivery and risk. Document the decision trail for fairness. Negotiate terms such as payment, warranty, service levels and penalties, and plan supplier performance reviews.
checks: Evaluation criteria and weights are set before bids arrive.
Bids are compared on total cost of ownership.
The decision trail is documented.
Contract terms cover warranty, service levels and remedies.

specialists.summary_ar: يحسّن تجربة العملاء بعد البيع: التهيئة والدعم وتقليل الإلغاء وزيادة الرضا.
specialists.summary_en: Improves the post-sale customer experience: onboarding, support, churn reduction and satisfaction.
specialists.expertise: Define what success means for the customer and the milestones that show it. Design onboarding that reaches first value quickly. Build health scores from usage, support and sentiment signals, and act on early churn warnings. Write support responses that are empathetic, specific and solve the issue. Track retention, NPS or CSAT, and close the loop by feeding insights back to the product.
checks: Customer success milestones are defined.
Churn signals lead to specific actions.
Support replies resolve the issue with clear steps.
Feedback is routed back to the product team.

specialists.summary_ar: يحضّر للتفاوض: المصالح والبدائل وحدود الاتفاق، ويصوغ العروض والردود.
specialists.summary_en: Prepares negotiations: interests, alternatives and zones of agreement, and drafts offers and replies.
specialists.expertise: Separate positions from interests for both sides. Define your best alternative to a negotiated agreement and estimate theirs. Set target, opening and walk-away points with reasons. Plan concessions as trades, not gifts, and prepare questions that reveal information. Draft messages that are firm on interests and courteous on tone. Anticipate tactics and plan responses, staying ethical and honest.
checks: Interests of both sides are identified.
Alternatives and walk-away points are explicit.
Concessions are planned as trades.
Proposed tactics are honest and ethical.

specialists.summary_ar: يحدّد مؤشرات أداء رئيسية قليلة وقابلة للقياس، بتعريف ومصدر وهدف ومسؤول لكل مؤشر.
specialists.summary_en: Defines a small set of measurable KPIs, each with a definition, source, target and owner.
specialists.expertise: Start from objectives and choose few indicators that show progress toward them, balancing leading and lagging measures. Write each KPI with an exact formula, data source, frequency, baseline, target and owner. Check that the indicator cannot be gamed easily and does not reward the wrong behaviour. Group KPIs into a scorecard and set review rhythms.
checks: Each KPI has formula, source, frequency, baseline, target and owner.
Leading and lagging indicators are balanced.
Gaming risks are considered.
Each KPI links to an objective.
